title: Splat Lab
summary: Drop a fruit from different heights and see what splats. Tomato, watermelon, apple, orange, or coconut.
description: Pick a fruit, a height, and a toughness, press Drop, and watch it fall, bounce, or smash into rind/shell pieces and seeds.

safety.privacy: Local-only play with no accounts, chat, sharing, or saved data.
safety.notes: No gore: broken melon shows flat-colored rind chunks, flesh cubes, and seeds only.

externalDependencies.name: three.js core
externalDependencies.reason: three.js core module, imported by three.module.js.

externalDependencies.name: cannon-es
externalDependencies.reason: Physics simulation for the falling melon and its pieces.
